entry_route.value: Applicants with a relevant bachelor's can enter the BS-to-PhD track, and a master's from another department is also considered.
entry_route.quote: Students with a bachelor’s degree in environmental science, geosciences, biology, chemistry, mathematics, or engineering will be considered for the BS to PhD track

also.quote: Successful completion of a master’s degree in another department is viewed positively

supervisor.value: Applicants without a faculty advisor who has agreed to supervise them are denied admission.
supervisor.quote: Candidates without an advisor will be denied admission to this program. | The advisor must have agreed to supervise the candidate.
